text: Foster carer here, I have an 11 month old girl who's been running a temp today. She's on calpol and ibuprofen and inbetween doses she's fine, playing, drinking her bottles, babbling away. Just letting you know in case anyone asks, the purple marks on her legs are from her foster brothers felt tips, scrubbed them in the bath and they came strait off. Just wanted to check how long I should keep going with the medicine for
